purpose: Replace the next reviewed group of misleading or learner-hostile high-reuse glosses with common lexical meanings and concrete component images.
selection_rule: Only include families whose current gloss is clearly inaccurate, archaic English, or materially less useful than a well-supported concrete image.

刀.reason: 刀 ordinarily means knife or saber and depicts a knife; sword incorrectly teaches the graph as 劍/剑.

䂶.reason: Crustacean replaces the unnatural taxonomic fragment the Crustacea.

䄂.reason: Pray and curse removes a malformed infinitive while preserving the ancient ritual sense.

㦾.reason: Door bolt is concise and avoids embedding the article the inside every equation and sentence.

㧀.reason: Door bolt is concise and avoids embedding the article the inside every equation and sentence.

气.reason: Air is the common modern meaning of 气 and the concrete image reused throughout its component family; steam is an older, narrower sense.

户.reason: Household is the useful modern lexical meaning, while the graph depicts a one-leaf door and functions far more clearly as door in descendants.

戹.reason: In difficulty retains the meaning while removing erroneous title casing.

炎.reason: Inflammation remains a useful lexical target, but two fires make flames the concrete reusable image in descendants.

剡.reason: Sharp replaces the malformed target Sharp-Pointed Sharp while preserving the character's core cutting sense.

由.reason: Cause preserves the central source/reason sense without teaching the obsolete English word wherefore.

庙.reason: Temple is the ordinary meaning of the simplified character 庙; imperial was an adjective fragment.

至.reason: Reach or arrive is the graph's concrete core meaning and yields clearer descendant mnemonics than the grammatical word until.

氳.reason: Life-giving influence aligns the traditional form with 氲 and fixes inconsistent hyphenation and number.

牖.reason: Window restores the actual lexical meaning that had been truncated to the unrelated word lead.

紬.reason: Thread aligns 紬 with its simplified variant 䌷 and removes erroneous title casing.

舮.reason: Bow of a boat is concise natural English for the same nautical sense.

䝞.reason: Name of an immortal restores the local dictionary definition in place of an unrelated fragment.

䝡.reason: Ancient animal expresses the same rare sense in clear modern English.

豸.reason: The graph is an animal pictograph and heads a beast radical family; beast explains its descendants far better than worm-like invertebrate.
